sources.title: Singapore FM’s visit focused on enhancing cooperation in trade, infrastructure and digital technologies: FO
Europe and Canada detail first measures after unprecedented rapprochement

en.title: No Report of Singapore FM Visiting Canada
en.dek: Sources do not mention a visit by Singapore’s foreign minister to Canada.
facts: S1 reports that Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar hosted Singapore’s Foreign Minister Dr Vivian Balakrishnan in Pakistan.
S1 notes the meeting focused on trade, investment, agriculture, infrastructure, and digital technologies.
S2 reports a two‑day summit in Montréal between European Union leaders and the Canadian prime minister.
S2 notes measures on Erasmus, instant money transfers, a digital trade agreement, critical materials, and AI cooperation.
Neither source mentions a Singapore FM visit to Canada.
body: S1 reports that Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar hosted Singapore’s Foreign Minister Dr Vivian Balakrishnan in Pakistan, where the meeting focused on trade, investment, agriculture, infrastructure, and digital technologies.

S2 reports that a two‑day summit in Montréal between European Union leaders and the Canadian prime minister produced measures on Erasmus, instant money transfers, a digital trade agreement, critical materials, and AI cooperation.
Neither source mentions a Singapore FM visit to Canada, and no statement from the Singapore or Canadian foreign offices appears in the articles.
The sources provide no evidence of the event described by the user, so no factual basis exists for the claimed visit.
en.context: S1 covers a Singapore-Pakistan diplomatic visit, while S2 covers a EU-Canada summit held in Montréal.

problemsFixed: Paragraphs lacked longer sentences with two clauses; repeated sentence openings; each paragraph had only one sentence, which may not meet the requirement for longer sentences with two clauses.
